vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component defines the core data structures for the physics subsystem, acting as the primary data model for physical entities. It encapsulates properties like mass, damping coefficients, and the physical state (Static, Dynamic, Kinematic) of an object. It serves as the interface layer between the game object representation and the underlying physics solver, defining constraints rather than executing simulation logic.

graph_nodes.label: Type
graph_nodes.name: ColliderShape
graph_nodes.signature: enum ColliderShape { Box, Sphere, Capsule, Plane, Mesh }

graph_nodes.label: Interface
graph_nodes.name: PhysicsWorldSettings
graph_nodes.signature: interface PhysicsWorldSettings { gravity: Vector3; timeStep: number; }

graph_nodes.label: Class
graph_nodes.name: RigidbodyComponent
graph_nodes.signature: class RigidbodyComponent { public type: RigidbodyType = RigidbodyType.Dynamic; public mass: number = 1.0; public linearDamping: number = 0.0; public angularDamping: number = 0.0; }

graph_nodes.label: Class
graph_nodes.name: ColliderComponent
graph_nodes.signature: class ColliderComponent { public shape: ColliderShape = ColliderShape.Box; public size: Vector3 = new Vector3(1, 1, 1); public isTrigger: boolean = false; public friction: number = 0.5; public restitution: number = 0.0; }

graph_nodes.label: Interface
graph_nodes.name: PhysicsTransform
graph_nodes.signature: interface PhysicsTransform { position: Vector3; rotation: quat; isDirty?: boolean; }
